summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Dimensional US Large Cap Value ETF (DFLV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed to hold a broad and diversified selection of US large-cap companies of any sector that exhibit value characteristics. Portfolio holdings are weighted by market capitalization DFLV was launched on Dec 6, 2022 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DFLV is an equity ETF with a total of 338 individual holdings. The top holdings are JPMorgan Chase & Co. stock at 4.57%, Amazon.com at 4.47%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 3.71%, Meta Platforms at 2.53%, and Johnson & Johnson at 2.42%.
